test.title: Bus company — refunds and lost property

paragraphs.text: If a bus is more than 30 minutes late, passengers may claim a refund of the single fare within 14 days. Claims are made online; the ticket or a photograph of it must be attached.
Items left on a bus are kept at the depot for 28 days. Small items are returned free of charge; bicycles and pushchairs cost £10 to collect. The depot is open on weekdays only.

document.title: Bus company — refunds and lost property

items.quote: If a bus is more than 30 minutes late, passengers may claim a refund
items.prompt: A refund can be claimed for a delay of 20 minutes.

explanation.en: A refund applies to delays over 30 minutes → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Возврат — при опоздании больше 30 минут → FALSE.

items.quote: the ticket or a photograph of it must be attached
items.prompt: Claims must include the ticket or a picture of it.

explanation.en: The ticket or a photo of it is required → TRUE.
explanation.kk: Билет не оның суреті керек → TRUE.
explanation.ru: Нужен билет или его фото → TRUE.

items.quote: Items left on a bus are kept at the depot for 28 days
items.prompt: Lost items are kept for a month.

explanation.en: 28 days is about a month → TRUE.

items.quote: bicycles and pushchairs cost £10 to collect

explanation.en: A pushchair costs £10 to collect → FALSE.
